nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Collector for course_id=2 (AAA-2014J). Follow this recipe once, aggregate after the terminal page, and return immediately — never re-read a page, re-run aggregation, or loop to re-verify: (1) Call canvas_get_course(course_id=2) once; record name, course_code, and total_students; SHORT NAME = name with the trailing " (Fall 2014)" removed. (2) Enrollment: call canvas_get_course_grades(course_id=2, type=["StudentEnrollment"], per_page=100, page=1..) following pagination.has_more, counting ALL returned enrollments regardless of enrollment_state. Record the enrolled user_id set. (3) Quiz_Count: call canvas_list_quizzes(course_id=2) once (including unpublished); count stable quiz IDs. (4) Assignment_Count: call canvas_list_assignments(course_id=2) once; count stable assignment IDs excluding any non-null quiz assignment_id. (5) Avg_Score: paginate canvas_list_student_submissions(course_id=2, per_page=100, page=1..terminal) once per page stopping only at pagination.has_more=false, deduplicating stable row.id values; per-student mean over each student's non-null graded scores, then the mean across those per-student means rounded to two decimals (students with no graded submissions excluded). Return ONLY the compact JSON {course_id:2, course_code, short_name, enrollment, avg_score, assignment_count, quiz_count, graded_student_count, duplicate_submission_ids}; keep raw rows out of the main context and make no writes.
